label: Pitcher cold-start repair research; development only

bootstrap.fav_convention: % replicates favoring challenger; negative deltas favor second arm

clip: [1e-6, 1-1e-6] on all arm outputs; no tuning
league_prior: 0.223813 (ratified; used as shrinkage target and fallback in ALL P arms for comparability)

P1.prior_source: pitcher_games 2023 rows (>=9-PA appearances) aggregated per pitcher
P1.fallback: 0.223813 when PA_prior_season==0 (no prior season / prior role below eligibility)
P1.known_limitation: prior includes any >=9-PA appearance (mixed roles inseparable historically); relief-only priors not separable; disclosed

P2.m_selection: m in {100,200,300} selected by 2023-only pitcher-only logloss (two chronological 2023 blocks pooled), NEVER on 2024 E1/E2

arms.P4: OMITTED before hashing: no exact pre-registered short-deviation formulation exists in repo evidence

forms: each arm evaluated pitcher-only AND in log5 with the unchanged PA-1A batter component (b_k_rate_std_shrunk)

evaluation.blocks: E1 2024-03-28..06-30 (n=55,815); E2 2024-07-01..09-30 (n=50,252); primary population = PA-1A primary 2024 rows, identical rows across arms
evaluation.metrics: logloss primary; brier, CITL, alpha/beta, ECE-20bin secondary; paired date-cluster bootstrap; game_pk sensitivity

selection_rule: at most one arm promoted for development; qualifies only if: improves M2 logloss in BOTH blocks; brier not materially worse in either; improves early-season buckets; no late-season material degradation; calibration not materially worse; not confined to one month/subset; pregames reproducible; deterministic. Order: both-block logloss stability > early-season gain > brier > calibration > simplicity > fallback dependence. Pooled never decisive.
